messages:
maria: Heads-up — planning a gradual canary for the 2.3.0 runtime change today. Target window 17:30-18:30 PT. Who can own the deploy?
alex: I can drive the deploy + monitor. planning to start at 17:35 PT.
jamal: I’ll own smoke verification and metrics. will run the perf smoke script and check latency dashboards.
kevin: I’ll be on-call during the window for rollback if needed. ping me when you hit 5% and 20%.
deploy-bot: scheduled deploy 2.3.0 -> canary-slice at 2026-03-17T17:35:00Z (initiated by alex) :white_check_mark:
maria: Canary cohorts: start with internal-beta (company staff) -> 1% external cohort A (low-volume regions) -> 5% cohort B (EU + NA small geos) -> 20% cohort C (broader NA) -> 50% if green.
alex: Agreed. Roll at: 0% -> 1% (5m) -> 5% (10m) -> 20% (15m) -> 50% (30m). We’ll pause at each step for signal checks.
jamal: Smoke checklist (short):
```
- smoke: run smoke/perf-check.sh --seq=512 --qps=50
- check console: /dash/latency/runtime-2.3.0 (1m/5m/15m)
- logs: grep ERROR /var/log/infer/runtime.log | tail -n 30
- memory: node-exporter runtime GPU mem and host mem
```
kevin: Add SLOs to watch: p95 latency, error-rate (>0.5% alert), token drop anomalies. set manual hold if p95 > 250ms for >3min.
alex: Will post a short runbook in thread before start. Also leaving a quick rollback command: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/runtime --to-revision=3` and `route traffic set canary=0` in the infra tool.
maria: Who will own the canary abort decision? suggest jamal + kevin co-decision, alex executes.
jamal: fine. If error-rate spikes or regression on quality tests, we abort. Also will run 5 quick eval prompts to check generation drift.
kevin: I’ll be standing by; ping me with :rotating_light: if we need to abort.
alex: small ask — please monitor the cache hit rate and kv-cache miss ratio. the change touches cache eviction.
maria: noted. jamal will watch cache and perf.
jamal: quick note: we'll exclude enterprise customers (tenant flag) from the initial cohorts — backend filter already in the canary config.
alex: ok. I’ll start deploy at 17:35 PT. posting runbook now.
deploy-bot: deploy started: 2.3.0 -> canary-slice (1%) at 2026-03-17T17:35:12Z
maria: On first 1% now. jamal, can you run smoke script and drop results here?
jamal: smoke run complete: latency p50 60ms, p95 190ms, error-rate 0.03%. cache miss 3.1%. no obvious errors.
kevin: holding for 10m then proceed to 5% if stable.
alex: moving to 5% in 5m.
deploy-bot: traffic scaled to 5% at 2026-03-17T17:46:00Z
jamal: 5% check: p95 205ms, error-rate 0.05%, eval prompts passed. cache miss 3.8% (slight uptick).
maria: good. proceed to 20% per plan.
alex: scaling to 20% now.
deploy-bot: traffic scaled to 20% at 2026-03-17T17:58:30Z
jamal: 20% check: p95 220ms, error-rate 0.25% (still under threshold), no new errors. I’ll keep watching next 15m.
kevin: still OK from SRE side.
maria: leaving a note to schedule full rollback rehearsal next week to make the procedure less manual.
aj: thanks everyone.
